<!--
  How it works: numbered or icon steps in a row or a column. Axes: layout (row, column), marker (number, icon),
  align, density, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Step } from "./steps-list.types";

export type StepsListProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  steps: Step[];
  layout?: "row" | "column";
  marker?: "number" | "icon";
  align?: "start" | "center";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import IconBadge from "../primitives/iconbadge/icon-badge.vue";
import List from "../primitives/list/list.vue";
import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  steps,
  layout = "row",
  marker = "number",
  align = "start",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<StepsListProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    :align="align"
    :measure="(((layout as string) === 'row') ? 'default' : '2xl')"
  >
    <List
      tag="ol"
      :class="cn('grid gap-6', (((layout as string) === 'row') ? 'sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4' : ''))"
      data-testid="items"
    >
      <ListItem v-for="(step, i) in steps" :key="step.id"
        :class="cn(
          'flex gap-4',
          (((layout as string) === 'row') ? 'flex-col' : ''),
          (((align as string) === 'center') ? 'items-center text-center' : '')
        )"
        data-testid="item"
      >
        <IconBadge variant="primary" data-slot="marker">
          <LucideIcon v-if="((marker as string) === 'icon')" :name="step.icon" :size="20" />
          <Text v-else size="base" weight="bold">
            {{ ((i + 1) == null ? undefined : String((i + 1))) }}
          </Text>
        </IconBadge>
        <Stack gap="2" :align="(((align as string) === 'center') ? 'center' : 'start')">
          <Title :as="3" size="xl" weight="bold">
            {{ step.title }}
          </Title>
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ step.text }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </ListItem>
    </List>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
